facts.fact: Perla 确认侄女出门后去探 Ulises 房间；他原是她用来逼 Cándido 摊牌的「小摆件」，见面后开始重新考虑
facts.anchor: Ulises Linares was supposed to be a trinket to show off around town

facts.fact: Perla 的过去：有过多段无名情人（去 Veracruz 港借口看表亲）与已婚推销员 Plutarco
facts.anchor: There had been men in her life. Nameless, faceless men

facts.fact: 婚期争论：他坚称三周，她纠正为两周，离房时她松口说三周
facts.anchor: “Two weeks,” she corrected him. “In your letter you said you could stay for two weeks.”

facts.fact: 闪回：三兄妹——兄 Osorio Natalicio（Natito，1898 年圣诞夜生）、Perla、妹 Encarnación（小 11 个月）
facts.anchor: his full name is Osorio Natalicio, in honor of Christ Our Savior, but they call him Natito

facts.fact: 父亲家训：女人是家族的宝石或烂肉；Perla 是「完美儿童」，Encarnación 反叛
facts.anchor: A woman who disgraces her family’s name is like a decomposed piece of meat

facts.fact: 1910 革命+咖啡价跌：父亲借美国人大笔债务苦撑；1918 大流感夺走 20 岁的 Natito
1919 年 12 月父亲安排 Perla 嫁咖啡商之子 Norberto Bustillo 以合并公司续命
facts.anchor: “Without Natito, I’ll have to depend on a son-in-law to manage the business. It will be a distinguished match.”

facts.fact: 姐妹夜话：Encarnación 已爱上 Rómulo（有妇之夫）；Perla 相信自己要嫁国王当王后
facts.anchor: “I’m going to marry a king, and I’ll be a queen. Like Father told us when we were little.”
